execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"
CREATE TYPE "public"."Author" AS ENUM ('USER', 'MODEL')
CREATE TYPE "public"."MemoryCategory" AS ENUM ('IDENTITY', 'PREFERENCES', 'PROJECTS', 'SKILLS', 'CONSTRAINTS')
CREATE TYPE "public"."MemoryStability" AS ENUM ('SHORT_TERM', 'MEDIUM_TERM', 'LONG_TERM')
CREATE TYPE "public"."UploadKind" AS ENUM ('ATTACHMENT', 'SKILL', 'GITHUB')

CREATE TABLE "public"."account" (
  "accessToken" text,
  "accessTokenExpiresAt" timestamp(3),
  "accountId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "idToken" text,
  "password" text,
  "providerId" text NOT NULL,
  "refreshToken" text,
  "refreshTokenExpiresAt" timestamp(3),
  "scope" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "account_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."action" (
  "config" "jsonb" NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" "jsonb" NOT NULL,
  "embedding" "vector",
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastRanAt" timestamp(3),
  "messageId" text NOT NULL,
  "schedule" text NOT NULL,
  "timezone" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "action_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."chat" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "folderId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "incognito" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "temporary" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "title" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "chat_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."chat_memory" (
  "chatId" text NOT NULL,
  "memoryId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "chat_memory_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("chatId", "memoryId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."dream" (
  "config" "jsonb" NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" "jsonb" NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata" "jsonb" NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "dream_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."dream_message" (
  "dreamId" text NOT NULL,
  "messageId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "dream_message_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("messageId", "dreamId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."file" (
  "chatId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" bytea NOT NULL,
  "embedding" "vector",
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mime" text NOT NULL,
  "path" text[] NOT NULL,
  "uploadId" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "file_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."folder" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cwd" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "folder_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."memory" (
  "category" "MemoryCategory" NOT NULL,
  "confidence" float8 NOT NULL,
  "config" "jsonb",
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "embedding" "vector",
  "evidence" text[] NOT NULL,
  "fact" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "messageId" text,
  "stability" "MemoryStability" NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "memory_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."message" (
  "author" "Author" NOT NULL,
  "chatId" text NOT NULL,
  "config" "jsonb" NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" "jsonb" NOT NULL,
  "embedding" "vector",
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata" "jsonb" NOT NULL,
  "previousId" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "message_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" text,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "session_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."subagent" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" "jsonb" NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "messageId" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata" "jsonb" NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "subagent_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."upload" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" "UploadKind" NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "thumbnail" bytea,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "upload_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "cache" "jsonb" DEFAULT '{}'::"jsonb" NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image" text,
  "isAnonymous" bool DEFAULT false,
  "isEphemeral" bool DEFAULT false,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "settings" "jsonb" DEFAULT '{}'::"jsonb" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "user_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."verification" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "verification_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
CREATE INDEX "account_userId_idx" ON "public"."account" ("userId")
CREATE INDEX "action_messageId_idx" ON "public"."action" ("messageId")
CREATE INDEX "action_userId_idx" ON "public"."action" ("userId")

CREATE INDEX "chat_memory_memoryId_idx" ON "public"."chat_memory" ("memoryId")
CREATE INDEX "dream_userId_idx" ON "public"."dream" ("userId")
CREATE INDEX "dream_message_dreamId_idx" ON "public"."dream_message" ("dreamId")
CREATE INDEX "dream_message_messageId_idx" ON "public"."dream_message" ("messageId")
CREATE INDEX "file_chatId_idx" ON "public"."file" ("chatId")
CREATE INDEX "file_uploadId_idx" ON "public"."file" ("uploadId")
CREATE INDEX "file_userId_idx" ON "public"."file" ("userId")
CREATE INDEX "folder_userId_idx" ON "public"."folder" ("userId")
CREATE INDEX "memory_messageId_idx" ON "public"."memory" ("messageId")
CREATE INDEX "memory_userId_idx" ON "public"."memory" ("userId")
CREATE INDEX "message_chatId_idx" ON "public"."message" ("chatId")
CREATE INDEX "message_previousId_key" ON "public"."message" ("previousId")
CREATE INDEX "message_userId_idx" ON "public"."message" ("userId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "session_token_key" ON "public"."session" ("token")
CREATE INDEX "session_userId_idx" ON "public"."session" ("userId")
CREATE INDEX "subagent_messageId_idx" ON "public"."subagent" ("messageId")
CREATE INDEX "subagent_userId_idx" ON "public"."subagent" ("userId")
CREATE INDEX "upload_userId_idx" ON "public"."upload" ("userId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "user_email_key" ON "public"."user" ("email")
CREATE INDEX "verification_identifier_idx" ON "public"."verification" ("identifier")
